svg.title: How far the eight models disagree, five steps ahead, over room and outside temperature
svg.desc: Two grids, door shut and door open, of the width of the band after five steps with the heater on. Dark cells are narrow and light cells wide. The band widens with the gap between room and outside, not with distance from the log: dots mark cells where the log has twenty or more rows within a degree, and widths run from 0.09 to 1.76 degrees.
